mapper.select: SELECT card_id, bank_code_std, card_number_masked, card_name, card_member_type FROM mock_card_info WHERE ci = #{ci} ORDER BY card_id
SELECT card_id, card_num_masked, card_name, card_member_type FROM mock_card_info WHERE ci = #{ci} AND bank_code_std = #{bankCodeStd} ORDER BY card_id

SELECT b.charge_month, b.settlement_seq_no, b.card_id, b.charge_amt, b.settlement_day, b.settlement_date, b.credit_check_type FROM mock_card_bill b JOIN mock_card_info c ON b.card_id = c.card_id WHERE b.ci = #{ci} AND c.bank_code_std = #{bankCodeStd} AND b.charge_month BETWEEN #{fromMonth} AND #{toMonth} ORDER BY b.charge_month, b.card_id, b.settlement_seq_no
